ingredients.name: Ferment (kombucha, water kefir, tepache)

source.name: Mixtura
source.note: docs/non-alcoholic.md, Ingredient class table for the data model

ingredients.notes: Contains ethanol and no typical ABV can be given: kombucha 0 to 3.62 % observed in 684 samples, below 0.016 % under NCHFP's controlled recipe. The data holds the value the user measured or the label states; an unmeasured ferment has an unknown ABV, not 0. Acid is a pH (kombucha 2.5 to 3.8), not a percentage. Ethanol can rise during storage.
